shots.line: Now go back to October thirtieth, twenty-fourteen.
shots.what: real: helicopter view of the hangar (src 26.6-30.0 only: after 32 s the report cuts to a DIFFERENT airport); chapter lettering types on

shots.line: The field, the hangar,
shots.what: 3D callback: the hangar at dusk

shots.line: the black hat.
shots.what: 3D callback: the black hat

shots.line: The US Marshals had made the arrest,
shots.what: real: the marshals team

shots.line: but this was a state police case,
shots.what: real photo: the Blooming Grove barracks sign

shots.line: and the man they'd caught had killed one of their own.
shots.what: Cpl. Dickson's portrait

shots.line: So the Marshals handed Eric Frein over to the Pennsylvania State Police,
shots.what: real: the arrest night, officers under blue lights

shots.line: and the troopers who took him put Corporal Bryon Dickson's handcuffs on him.
shots.what: 3D object: a pair of handcuffs, amber, the camera flies in and lands on them at "handcuffs" (music out)

shots.line: Then they put him in Dickson's patrol car
shots.what: real: Frein in the back of the patrol car that night

shots.line: and drove him back to Blooming Grove.
shots.what: road map: an amber line from the airpark to the barracks (a straight line, labelled as such)

map.sub: STRAIGHT LINE SHOWN, NOT THE ROAD ROUTE

shots.line: State Police Commissioner Frank Noonan confirmed it.
shots.what: real: Noonan interviewed; name tag types on

shots.line: Pennsylvania's governor at the time, Tom Corbett,
shots.what: real: Gov. Corbett at the press conference; name tag types on

shots.line: called it very appropriate.
shots.what: typed quote card

shots.line: Forty-eight days after Corporal Bryon Dickson was killed outside Blooming Grove,
shots.what: 3D: the barracks lot at night; 48 DAYS LATER types on

shots.line: his patrol car pulled back into the barracks.
shots.what: 3D: the cruiser, an amber edge of light on it, turning into the lot (the pay-off of the planted detail)

shots.line: Eric Frein was in the back seat wearing Dickson's handcuffs.
shots.what: real photo: troopers lead him from the barracks that night; held, slowest push, music out

shots.line: So here's my question for you.
shots.what: 3D object: the handcuffs

shots.line: The state police chose to bring him back in Dickson's handcuffs in Dickson's car.
shots.what: 3D: low along the cruiser in its bay

shots.line: Was that the right call? Tell me what you think in the comments.
shots.what: typed question card

card.who: TELL ME WHAT YOU THINK IN THE COMMENTS

shots.line: If you want another one about a man who vanished into the woods with the whole country looking for him, watch my video on the Olympic bomber who stayed hidden for five years.
shots.what: end card: the Olympic Bomber video's thumbnail

shots.line: And subscribe if you want more of these. There are plenty more coming.
shots.what: typed end card
